figures.before: Why Jacksonville Roofs Need Annual Pre-Season Attention
figures.alt: Florida asphalt-shingle roof with ridge vent, sound penetration boot, drip edge, and an orderly pre-season inspection kit
figures.caption: Pre-season roof preparation is about finding manageable maintenance issues before wind, driven rain, debris, and a compressed repair market turn them into larger failures.

figures.alt: Asphalt-shingle roof ridge with a properly capped ridge vent, aligned courses, and clean roof planes
figures.caption: A useful inspection works through the roof system rather than looking only for obvious leaks: field shingles, ridge, edges, penetrations, flashing, gutters, soffits, and the attic-side evidence of moisture.

figures.alt: Roof plumbing penetration with correctly integrated pipe boot flashing and neatly seated asphalt shingles
figures.caption: Penetrations and transitions deserve close attention because a small failure in a boot or flashing detail can admit water where the roof changes direction or material.
